about: Shared contract cases for the project property time-color-for-jira (PROJECT_PROFILE.md). extension/forge: whether each side must accept the value. Used by tests here and by the admin tool that writes the property.

cases.description: valid: full profile with holidays and make-up workdays
valid: no holiday lists, only weekends
valid: Epic stripe with a flag field
valid: settings may be empty (defaults apply)
invalid: same issue type in two roles
invalid: same day as holiday and workday
invalid: holiday name with angle brackets
invalid: holiday name longer than 50 characters
invalid: weekend day out of range
invalid: working days need a start date field
invalid: target end shade needs a target end field
invalid: Epic stripe needs a flag field
invalid: highlight value with angle brackets
invalid: color given as an array
invalid: holidays is null (omit it instead)
invalid: revision given as a string
valid: minimal profile with features off and no fields
invalid: Timeline path is an external URL
invalid: Timeline path longer than 500 characters
invalid: boolean setting given as a string
invalid: progress switch given as a string
differs: no issue types at all
forward: extra field with a non-customfield value
forward: extra fields with a number, object and array
forward: extra key in a holiday entry
forward: unknown profile section with nested data
forward: unknown key in progress and template
invalid: known setting with a wrong type next to an unknown one
invalid: __proto__ key in an unknown section
